newsitem.title: IRAN: Vasectomy gains popularity in Iran - official.
newsitem.headline: Vasectomy gains popularity in Iran - official.

text.p: Vasectomies have gained popularity in Iran with increasing numbers of operations, a health official said on Monday.

Some 1,455 vasectomies were performed during the first half of the current Iranian year which began on March 20, 1996, said Hamidreza Sadeqqi-Pour, deputy for health affairs of the Medical Sciences University of Tehran.
The number of operations during the same period in the previous year was 435, he told the official Islamic Republic News Agency.
